meta.note: Sumber instance dari sampel ≤300/frame (194.275 instance terhitung).

patterns.name: App shell
structure: GUN Page Layout Template (1440×900)
slot Navigation Rail ← GUN Rail {Active=<modul>}
slot Sidebar ← GUN Sidebar-<SWT|User Mgmt|Asset|Settings New> {Open Menu}
slot Header ← SHIELD Header Nav {Breadcrumb=1} (478/478)
slot Body 1096×792 ← pola P02–P08
rules: Tinggi frame mengikuti isi (900–2364); Page Layout Template ikut membesar.
Body selalu dimulai SHIELD Page Header (≈120 layar) atau langsung Section Layout - Table dengan Section Header.

patterns.name: List + tabel
patterns.when: Daftar data: Booking List, Training Results, Asset/User/Rank, Activity Log, Settings tabel.
structure: [SHIELD Page Header]
GUN Section Layout - Table {Table is=Default|Scrollable|No Pagin, Top Content, Mid Content}
Section Header (SHIELD) → judul + aksi kanan
slot Content ← tabel keluarga GUN (State=Filled|Empty|Search-Empty)
SHIELD Pagination (kecuali No Pagin)
rules: Filter, Add/Edit, dan konfirmasi adalah frame overlay terpisah (P11/P12), bukan di dalam frame list.
Tabel lebar didokumentasikan lewat frame 'Sticker' selebar 1440+1540·n (token sticker size).

patterns.name: List + tab
patterns.when: Tab di atas/dalam tabel: Notifications, tab Nominal Roll/Lane/Blackout pada detail, tab pada hasil pelatihan.
structure: Page Header (opsional)
GUN Section Layout - Table {Top Content=True}
slot 🔄 Top Content ← SHIELD Tab Group v2 {Number of Tab 2–8, With Margin}
slot Content ← tabel per tab

patterns.name: Detail bertab
patterns.when: Booking Details (per status), Training Result Details, Site Management Details.
structure: Page Header (Left Content Item: Booking Details|Assignment Details|Asset Details|User|Base Station…)
SHIELD Tab Group v2 {Number of Tab=4, With Margin=False} (tab paling umum)
GUN Booking Details - Details - <Upcoming|Ongoing|Return|Completed|Cancelled>  ATAU  Section Layout - Table
rules: Status booking memilih set GUN per status; ada varian Multi CW terpisah.

patterns.name: Detail berbasis section
patterns.when: Settings (General, Notification), Asset/User Details, Asset Tracking, System Health.
structure: Page Header
GUN Section Layout (1096 penuh, atau Row 536+536 dua kolom)
SHIELD Key Value / Input / Radio Group di slot Content
rules: Settings memakai Rail Active=Settings + Sidebar-Settings New.

patterns.name: Dashboard
structure: Page Header
Row: GUN Data Display - Booking ×2 (536×156)
GUN Data Display - Booking Team
GUN Calendar Dashboard - Day|Week|Range|Month {State}

patterns.name: Kalender booking
structure: Page Header
GUN Calendar Booking List - Day New|Week New|Month SWT {State}
rules: F-56: kartu kalender SHIELD menyarangkan Badge milik GUN.

patterns.name: Edit multi-tabel
structure: Page Header
Section Layout
Section Layout - Table {No Pagin}
Section Layout - Table {Scrollable} + SHIELD Scroll Bar + Pagination
rules: Mode Edit: frame 2000–2400px tinggi; state Edit - Add New Empty/Filled Error.

patterns.name: Wizard buat/ubah
patterns.when: Create Booking (5 langkah), Onboarding (4), Edit Detail List.
structure: GUN Page Layout Template - Create Booking (tanpa Rail/Sidebar)
slot Header ← GUN Header Nav - Create Booking {Program} | Header Nav - Onboarding {SWT-Collective|SWT-Marksmanship} | Header Nav - Edit Detail List | Header Nav - Ongoing Session
slot Wizard ← GUN Wizard - Create Booking {Located=First|Mid|Last, Skip Button} + swap Wizard Item
slot Body: kolom 640 (Wrapper) atau Row 1392 = Column 288 + Column 1080
rules: Langkah SWT: Create Booking → Schedule → Lane Config → Nominal Roll → Review (Modal).
Langkah Nominal Roll memakai Drawer Right (Add Trainee) dan Modal Import.

patterns.name: Login (tanpa shell)
structure: Frame 1440×900: gambar 800×900 + Right Content 640×900
Wrapper 384: Page Header, Form (SHIELD Input, Input - Password, Button lg primary)

patterns.name: Overlay: Drawer kanan
structure: Frame 1440×900 terpisah: SHIELD Drawer Right {Size=md 155× | lg 22× | 2xl 4×} + Scrim
Header: SHIELD Drawer Header; slot isi: GUN Filter - SWT - <halaman>, GUN Add Trainee SWT, SHIELD Input-Summary (Read Only), Alert - Booking Conflict with Blackout, Listbox
rules: Overlay tidak ditaruh di dalam frame halaman.

patterns.name: Overlay: Modal
structure: Frame 1440×900 terpisah: SHIELD Modal Confirmation {Status Warning sm 49× | Danger sm 13× | Warning md 10× | Neutral sm 5× | Success sm 2×}
atau SHIELD Modal {Size lg 47× | xs 18× | md 14× | full 6×, With Scroll Bar} + Modal Header + Scrim
domain: GUN Modal Confirmation - Delete|Remove|Move to archive|Cancel Booking|Bulk|Discard; Modal - SWT - Import Nominal Roll; Booking - Select Courseware/Assignment Modal

patterns.name: Toast
structure: SHIELD Toast with Container {Variant=Page|Default, Line, With Button} 1440×128 sebagai anak root frame halaman (di atas Body)
rules: State frame diberi nama 'Toast - Success'/'Toast - Saved'.

patterns.name: Anotasi (bukan layar)
structure: SHIELD Sticker/Notes dari Design Annotations; lebar 1440+1540·n
rules: Abaikan saat meniru layar; jangan dihitung sebagai pola.

markers.❌: layar ditinggalkan (nama halaman: Create Booking: Individual, All Reports, Assets Audit Report, System Maintenance)
markers.🟡: ditandai (Asset List, Assignment List, Issue Asset, System Health…); arti pasti belum dikonfirmasi
markers.🔴: Ongoing Session (Collective); arti pasti belum dikonfirmasi

legend.colorCodeSection: Halaman [INDEX] memuat kode warna: In Progress, In Review, Completed, Abandoned, Note/Info (cocok dengan variable collection Annotation di Graphene)
exclude: [Backlog] TRMS CV (99% memakai UI kit lain, bukan Graphene/SHIELD)
